question.prompt: What is the greatest integer solution of the inequality \(2(x-3)\geq5x+3\)?

solutions.explanation: Expanding gives \(2x-6\geq5x+3\). Rearranging gives \(-3x\geq9\). Dividing both sides by -3 gives \(x\leq-3\), so the greatest integer solution is -3.
solutions.title: Solve and select the integer endpoint
